description:
The CSS formatting for the project excludes any files matching **node_modules/****, **dist/**/*.css**, and **coverage/**/*.css**. Verbose output is turned off, while the tool is set to always add missing semicolons. Indentation uses tabs, hexadecimal colors are forced to lower‑case and are written in shorthand form, and element selectors are also lower‑cased. A final newline is required at the end of each file, but leading zeros are not added to dimension values. Single quotes are used for strings, empty rulesets are removed automatically, and vendor‑prefix alignment is disabled. Tab size is honoured, and the configuration runs without any additional console chatter.  

Spacing follows a consistent style: a single space after colons, combinators, opening braces, and selector delimiters, but no space after closing braces or before colons; a space is required before combinators and selector delimiters, while no space precedes opening braces. Declarations are separated by a newline, trailing spaces are stripped, and zero values are written without units. The sort order is defined in three groups—first the positioning properties (**position**, **top**, **right**, **bottom**, **left**), then layout properties (**display**, **float**, **width**, **height**, **margin**, **padding**), and finally colour‑related properties (**color**, **background-color**, **border-color**). Any properties not listed fall back to the “bottom” placement in the output.
